facility.name: Garden Montessori School
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,After School Care,Skill Classes,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 8644 BEVERLYHILL ST, HOUSTON, TX, 77063

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment: Two Employees did not have the date of employement listed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment (26 TAC §746.901(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Two employees did not have a signed form 2912.  Pre-employment Affidavit
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Licensing Parent Notification Poster: Operation did not have the Parent Notification Poster printed and posted.  NOTE: Director printed and posted at inspection to comply.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Licensing Parent Notification Poster (26 TAC §746.401(7))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System Tested: The checklist for carbon monoixde and smoke detectors is not current.  NOTE: Director tested and noted on checklist at inspection for compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System Tested (26 TAC §746.5315)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: Operation did not have a current fire marshal inspection report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Renewal background checks submitted -No later than 2 yrs from date you last submitted subjects initial or renewal name-based TX criminal hist check: Director did not have a renewed background check as of 2022.  Notice of renewal was sent 5/31/2025.  NOTE:  Director left premises at same time as Inspector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Renewal background checks submitted -No later than 2 yrs from date you last submitted subjects initial or renewal name-based TX criminal hist check (26 TAC §745.621(b)(1)(B))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System Tested: Documentation reviewed does not show that the smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors have been tested monthly. '
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System Tested (26 TAC §746.5315)

occurrences.finding: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies: 1 out of 10 children's files evaluated was missing the signature from parents for receiving a copy of the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Training certificates in the following topics was not available for review for 2 staff during the inspection:    Sudden Infant Death Syndrome  Early Childhood Brain Development  Shaken Baby Syndrome  Recognizing and Reporting Child Maltreatment
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions: Special care needs information was incomplete for 10 children's files evaluated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Limitations or Restrictions (26 TAC §746.605(13)(A))

occurrences.finding: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: The ac was not working properly in the nap room during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))

occurrences.finding: Medication No Longer Used: During the inspection, an Epi Pen was observed in a ziploc bag which had expired in May of 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §746.3809)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Documentation showing 2 staff meet the minimum educational requirements was not available to review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment: The employment start date was missing for 1 staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment (26 TAC §746.901(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission: Admission information for 10 children's files was incomplete. The information does not state whether children are able to swim without assistance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The annual sanitation inspection has not been conducted since January 19, 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: During the follow up inspection, dishes were observed on the hand washing sink again.     Note: The operation removed the dishes from the sink area during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink: Observed dishes on the hand washing sink in the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Other Use of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.2419(8))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System Tested: The smoke-detection system has not been tested since December 22nd, 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System Tested (26 TAC §746.5315)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: An annual fire inspection has not been conducted at the center since 11/28/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A wooden fence in the outdoor play are is missing several panels and poses a safety hazard to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A  caregiver was observed in the toddler room alone with 4 children. The caregivers background check status was inactive.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: The operation is currently not equipped with a carbon monoxide detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The diaper changing mat was torn in the infant room and cannot be properly cleaned.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: During the inspection, 10 children's files were evaluated. 9 files were missing the following information:    - Address and/or Phone # for Emergency contact person  - Releas Contact Name and Phone #  - No signature for receipt of operational policies
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: 1 out of 5 employee files evaluated did not contain documentation showing they meet education requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Documentation  pediatric CPR-1st aid includes participant's name, training date, training title, trainer's name, length of training: 1 out of 5 employee files evaluated did not contain the name of the certificate provided for CPR and First Aid Training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation  pediatric CPR-1st aid includes participant's name, training date, training title, trainer's name, length of training (26 TAC §746.1329(c)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The written operational policies did not include information regarding the promotion of physical activities. The following information was missing:    -The duration of physical activity at your operation, both indoor and outdoor  - The plan for physical activity on days when extreme weather prohibits or limits outdoor time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The provider did not have documentation showing the monthly maintenance checklists were completed for April or May.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: 1 out of 5 employee files evaluated did not have current CPR and First training available for review upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A food allergy emergency plan for a child with a diagnosed food allergy was not signed by the parent or a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: An active ant bed on the playground was observed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
